species.name: Muhlenbergia capillaris

existing.creator: David J. Stang
existing.actual_visual: Close-up airy slightly purple-pink mature flowering branches with tiny spikelets; plant base, foliage and collar not shown. Existing subject from commercial Maryland nursery.

need: whole bunch basal habit with distinct foliage
native wild population and identity evidence
dormant winter tuft / brown seed stage

candidates.creator: David J. Stang
candidates.view: Photo dominated by many fine upright gray-green leaf blades emerging from dark basal tuft, with delicate muted pink flowering wisps; not a detailed collar view.
candidates.role: fine leaf blades and basal clump
candidates.caution: Taken at Merrifield Garden Center, Fairfax VA. Seller-grown ornamental stock may involve cultivated selection; no cultivar status recorded on exact page. Useful for general habit but not a wild or Hays phenotype proof.

holds: Avoid many additional nearly identical ornamental pink-plume shots, or identifiable cultivar-tagged 'Fast Forward' photos.
A source-labeled nursery photo does not prove unselected wild species form; publisher should prioritize noncultivar material if available.
